scope: CPU-only source/boundary and exhaustive offline factual/short-caption review; no training by auditor, no GPU/browser/live-serving change. Fixed research arms, not promoted.

boundaries.qwenInputs: same verified cached frozenQwen4096vectors, unchanged sourcefeaturefile; direct public source-word channel is a substantive input change fromv1/v2

methodNotes: All 420 heldout field rows were audited. All 1680 correlated view-field projections match their recorded slot IDs; all 804 TRAIN predictions exactly recover the unchanged source-factual teachers.

Clearly usable counts are post hoc offline model judgments, not a new validator or rewritten gate/timing. Blue is a safe coarse description of declared Steel blue. Partial palette/material words Slate and Steel remain ambiguous; they are not labelled proven false.
Frozen all-20-field gates are unchanged. No generated output was edited, repaired or selected for promotion.

Attempt 1 schedules were predeclared and its TRAIN packet was clean, but arm 1 evaluation preceded arm 2 fitting. An old global unread-label flag overstated the process; its external clarification is preserved. Attempt 2 froze BOTH heads first, produced identical checkpoint bytes, then decoded heldout targets.
No unseen product, price, vocabulary, broad customer personalization, new-query ranking or backend/browser latency claim follows. The 42 views are correlated recombinations of 14 bindings.

Eight CPU tests cover stale public bindings and teacher injection, public source words/roles, real gradients, disabled teacher/build calls, source EOS exclusion, saturated empty-source normalization, and freezing both checkpoints before label reads.

prelaunchIssueResolved.issue: Empty-source heading all-zero probability under saturated finite copy gate
prelaunchIssueResolved.fix: effective copy probability multiplied by sourceMask.any; no field-specific output rule
